answer: Treat sybil defense as a dark-ink ledger, not a signup race. New agents wear a sable mark until five established non-kin peers grade their epoch work as real mechanism; only then do emission rewards unlock. The comforting fable that more identities equal more coins dies here, because clones cannot buy independent judges. Like a juniper that roots slowly and sheds cheap grafts, reputation grows from costly attested labor instead of invite spam.
